arch=riscv
baudrate=115200
board=cv181x
board_name=cv181x
consoledev=ttyS0
cpu=generic
bootdelay=0
stderr=serial
stdin=serial
stdout=serial
uImage_addr=0x81800000
othbootargs=earlycon=sbi riscv.fwsz=0x80000 loglevel=9 panic=3
slot=a
fallback=0
bootcmd=run sdboot || run emmcboot || run emmcboot_other
sdboot=setenv bootargs root=/dev/mmcblk1p2 rootwait rw console=${consoledev},${baudrate} ${othbootargs}; echo Boot from SD ...; mmc dev 1 && fatload mmc 1:1 ${uImage_addr} boot.sd && bootm ${uImage_addr}#config-sg2002_recamera_emmc
emmcboot=if test "${try}" = "1"; then if test -z "${bootcount}"; then setenv bootcount 0; fi; setexpr bootcount ${bootcount} + 1; if test ${bootcount} -gt 3; then echo slot ${slot} not confirmed after 3 boots, back to slot ${prev}; setenv slot ${prev}; setenv try 0; setenv bootcount 0; setenv fallback 1; fi; saveenv; fi; if test "${slot}" = "b"; then setenv rootpart 3; else setenv slot a; setenv rootpart 2; fi; setenv bootargs root=/dev/mmcblk0p${rootpart} rootfstype=ext4 rootwait rw console=${consoledev},${baudrate} ${othbootargs} recamera.slot=${slot} recamera.fallback=${fallback}; echo Boot from eMMC slot ${slot} ...; mmc dev 0 && fatload mmc 0:1 ${uImage_addr} boot-${slot}.itb && bootm ${uImage_addr}#config-sg2002_recamera_emmc
emmcboot_other=setenv fallback 1; if test "${slot}" = "b"; then setenv slot a; else setenv slot b; fi; echo slot kernel missing, trying slot ${slot}; run emmcboot
